item.title: Atelophobia
item.content:encoded:
https://www.wikidoc.org/index.php/Atelophobia

Maybe this term can become part of the site lexicon. For a -verse themed on creep, cosmic horror and the sanity cracks in hypermodernity, we forget the most pataphysically present form of fear for participants is article failure.
